name: A Date With: A Ghost girl
summary:
Find and befriend the cute ghost that lives in your new apartment! Learn to take care of her by taking care of yourself too, and help her evolve into a more powerful ghost by increasing her "Ectoplasm". This is a Hentai game so you know what I mean!

Almost 50 unlockable images of spicy ghost action (99 scenes total). Enjoy the spooky season by having a date with: a Ghost Girl. Booo!
